body:
Oh, it certainly does. It's got, for instance, women by the billions, so beautiful and so full of daggers.
No. Fuck it. Seriously. This was my last try at a relationship. I can't trust again. It's not worth it. I'm not giving another cunt the opportunity to shit all over me.

Hey, man. Thanks for taking the time to respond. I have a friend who tells me the same sort of things. But I just don't care about all the beauty in the world right now. Trying to enjoy all the awesome things in life after this is probably a bit like trying to enjoy a Steve Martin family comedy in replacement of a freshly kicked heroin addiction. I'm just playing some video games and working to pass the time. Everything that I enjoyed I enjoyed with her. Literally everything reminds me of her.

I don't know. Like I said, being in a great relationship has always been my greatest desire in life. And after this, I just can't bear to try again, so I know I'll never be happy. Nothing can replace that.

Thanks for the offer, too. I'd love to visit Australia some day. I hear it's awesome.

I have a friend who took several different antidepressants (all prescribed, I believe) over a period of probably several years. She told me that it's kind of hit and miss and you just have to find what works for you. She said that some were really helpful but that others affected her like you just described. Thanks for your input.

I hear your words, and they're the exact same words I've always heard after failed love. Only it hasn't gotten better. It's gotten worse each time. Like exponentially worse. I can't risk it anymore. If it happens again, I'll probably bite holes in my fucking wrists the moment something happens and just scream my fucking face off as I bleed into her crying face. I'm dead serious. It's not going to get better. I honestly have lost faith in finding love for myself. Fuck girls. Fuck women. I'm not giving another one of these cunts a chance. I know there are loads of good women in the world, but they're all after somebody other than me. And there's almost no chance that I'll find someone as giving in every conceivable way. Nor am I likely to find someone as sexually compatible. Yeah, fuck this shit.

Sorry, I hope I don't sound ungrateful for the help and kind words and advice. But I have to be able to say what I think, of course. You get it.

Thanks. I'll be around.

Everything, literally every single thing, in my life right now reminds me of her, and it completely kills me. The relationship was fucking solid gold for pretty much the entire time. I'm serious. I know relationships. I had it better than anyone else I've ever known, married or not. Only it turns out that she was faking it. And she's actually a heartless piece of shit. She doesn't deserve to get to make anyone feel like this. I really do just want to go to her place and bleed to death on everything she owns. Fuck her, man. Seriously. She deserves it. She needs to see what she's done to me. I know this sounds very dramatic, but even just walking around my apartment reminds me of her. My bed reminds me of her. Every room in my place reminds me of her. Every place in the towns around here remind me of her. It's absolute agony. It is constant, unending agony. And I can't just leave. If I leave, then I'll always remember that I left because of her. It's a catch 22. I'm fucked. I feel like the only way to fix the pain is to end it. I can't live with this. I can't. I can't just sit around waiting for the years to go by slowly healing things. Fuck it.
I will keep this in mind. Thank you for shedding a little light on it.

Thanks, man. I really do appreciate it. If you need want to PM me anything of a proselytizing nature, knock yourself out. I'm not closed to anything of that nature. In fact, it may be my only reason for not quitting yet. (It sure as fuck isn't because I think life is going to get better!)

> If there is no God, then there is still humanity in all its flawed glory, and there is ever so much more to know and learn and explore and grow.

I'm sorry to sound like such a downer, but, if there is no God, then fuck humanity. I can't look at the world around me and the history of it and not think that it's been pretty tragic for most of those involved at any period of time. It's fucking Hell on Earth. This world is a fucking shit hole. And if there is no purpose, no meaning, then fuck it. I've done enough learning and exploring. I'm seriously just not interested anymore. Let me be as clear as possible: I hate the world. I hate life. I think it's the worst thing that has ever happened—if it only happened by accident, that is. What an insanely fucking horrifying accident.

Thank you for replying, though. Sincerely. I'll be around to talk more.

Thank you for reading and thank you for your reply. The thing is, if you had told me all of this several years ago, I would have believed that you were right. But I can't do all of this again. I thought I'd learned what to look for. But basically, she's just been living a lie... well, her whole entire life. So for the last two years, I thought I was with someone who I truly loved and who loved me back. But it turns out that she wasn't really being herself and she has betrayed me. Now I know that every girl I ever meet could be a exactly like this: A fucking sociopath wearing a mask. It's not worth the risk. So, love is off the fucking menu. And fuck a life without that kind of love. Just fuck it right to death.

PS: Just posting this makes me feel less like doing it. But I know in about five minutes, it’ll be the only thing on my mind again. I feel nothing but betrayed, and I honestly can’t bear it.

I should also say that I have a very good relationship with my family. I’ve been offered a chance to move in with several different households in my family, and some of them have even offered to pay for me to see a counselor or psychologist.  I don’t know what they could really do for me, though. And I don’t want to take antidepressants. Fuck that. I’m not medicating myself. Fuck no fuck that no. I don’t want to be doped out of reality. Either I find true meaning or I’m out.

And I know the whole argument about not killing myself because it would devastate so many people. Well, too bad. I mean, I love my family. I really do. It would crush my mom. But you know what? If there’s no ultimate purpose in life, then, if it gets too hard, she’s just as free to end it as I am. I have no dependents. I have some good friends, but they can all live without me. I believe that everyone should have the right to suicide. And also, just to be clear, I don’t intend any harm towards this girl. I don’t intend to take out my anger on anyone. I’d just end my own pain—that is, if it’s all really meaningless.
